parse_urdf_robot_from_xml: parse a URDF robot description from an XML string or file using the Robot class
create_robot_link: create a Link object with name, visuals, collisions, and inertial properties for a robot
create_robot_joint: create a Joint object with type, parent, child, origin, and limit parameters for a robot
get_robot_chain: get the kinematic chain of joints and links between a root and tip link in a Robot
get_robot_root: get the root link name of a Robot by finding the link with no parent
